'''Shikma Schwarzmann-Bressler''' ({{langx|he|שקמה ברסלר}}; born July 10, 1980) is an Israeli physicist. A researcher at the [[Weizmann Institute of Science]], she is among those taking part in research at the [[CERN]] [[particle accelerator]] in [[Switzerland]] as a member of the [[ATLAS experiment|ATLAS collaboration]].<ref name="new-york-times-august-2023">{{cite web |last1=Kershner |first1=Isabel |author-link=Isabel Kershner |date=2 August 2023 |title=The Face of Israel's Protests Is a Particle Physicist |url=https://www.nytimes.com/2023/08/02/world/middleeast/shikma-bressler-israel-judicial-protests.html |url-access=subscription |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230825005453/https://www.nytimes.com/2023/08/02/world/middleeast/shikma-bressler-israel-judicial-protests.html |archive-date=August 25, 2023 |access-date=3 August 2023 |work=[[The New York Times]]}}</ref> She is also a social activist and leading figure in the "Black Flags" [[protests against Benjamin Netanyahu]].<ref name="the-marker-shikma-bressler">{{cite web |last1=Kopepper |first1=Ruta |title=Shikma Bressler, Initiator of "The Black Flag Protests" at #16 of the 100 Most Influential People List |url=https://www.themarker.com/magazine/EXT-INTERACTIVE-1.9112665 |publisher=[[The Marker]] |access-date=December 2, 2020 |language=he |date=2020}}</ref><ref name="weizmann-institute">{{cite web |title=Dr. Shikma Bressler Deeply Examines the Laws of Nature |url=https://www.weizmann.ac.il/pages/he/home/beyond-higgs |publisher=[[Weizmann Institute of Science]] |access-date=November 28, 2020 |language=he |date=2014}}</ref><ref name="haaretz-2">{{cite web |last1=Shpigel |first1=Noa |title=This is How a Whatsapp Conversation Between Three Brothers and a Sister Became "The Black Flag Protests" |url=https://www.haaretz.co.il/news/education/.premium-MAGAZINE-1.8708405 |publisher=[[Haaretz]] |access-date=December 2, 2020 |language=he |date=March 25, 2020}}</ref>

== Biography ==
Bressler was born in [[Haifa]], the second child of four, to a physician mother and a father who was a senior worker at [[Elbit Systems|Elbit systems]]. She grew up in [[Kibbutz]] [[Gvat]] and [[Timrat]]. When she was younger she played basketball on the [[Hapoel Galil Elyon]] basketball team and on Israel's youth national team. After her army service, Bressler moved on to play for {{ill|Hapoel Haifa W.B.C.|he|הפועל חיפה (כדורסל נשים)}}.<ref>{{cite web |last=מורן |first=מירב |date=2023-03-15 |title=איך הפכה הפיזיקאית שקמה ברסלר־שוורצמן לפנים של המחאה נגד ההפיכה. ראיון |url=https://www.haaretz.co.il/magazine/2023-03-15/ty-article-magazine/.highlight/00000186-e490-dacd-a9a7-fe96eb410000 |access-date=2025-03-19 |website=Haaretz הארץ |language=he}}</ref> She retired from basketball after she was injured and began her studies at the [[Technion – Israel Institute of Technology|Technion]]. She married and had two children. She later divorced and remarried and has five daughters.<ref name="ynet-basketball">{{cite web |last1=Vaknin |first1=Yossi |title=Women: Revolution at Ha'poel Galil Elyon |url=https://www.ynet.co.il/articles/0,7340,L-30122,00.html |publisher=[[Ynet]] |access-date=November 28, 2020 |language=he |date=July 11, 2000}}</ref>

== Scientific career ==
Bressler is a physicist at the [[Weizmann Institute of Science]]. She completed her bachelor's degree, with distinction, in physics and mathematics at the Technion, where she also completed her master's degree in physics in 2006 and a Ph.D. in 2011. In 2012, she joined the faculty at the Weizmann Institute.<ref name="weizmann-institute" /> In November 2023 she was nominated as associate professor.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Group Members {{!}} Shikma Bressler |url=https://www.weizmann.ac.il/particle/Bressler/group-members |access-date=2023-11-22 |website=www.weizmann.ac.il |language=en}}</ref>

In 2013, Bressler formed a team at the Weizmann Institute entrusted with the development of detectors and [[particle physics]].<ref>{{Cite news |last=Moran |first=Meirav |date=March 17, 2023 |title=How a Particle Physicist Became the Reluctant Face of Israel's Protest Movement |url=https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/2023-03-17/ty-article-magazine/.highlight/how-a-particle-physicist-became-the-reluctant-face-of-israels-protest-movement/00000186-f139-df90-a19e-f9bf0c940000 |url-access=subscription |url-status=live |archive-url=https://archive.today/20230318025937/https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/2023-03-17/ty-article-magazine/.highlight/how-a-particle-physicist-became-the-reluctant-face-of-israels-protest-movement/00000186-f139-df90-a19e-f9bf0c940000 |archive-date=March 18, 2023 |access-date=November 22, 2023 |work=[[Haaretz]]}}</ref> This team deals with the development of advanced concepts in the field of radiation detectors. She is an active researcher at the [[CERN]] particle accelerator in Switzerland, where she deals with gathering data from the [[ATLAS experiment]] in search of physics beyond the standard model of particle physics.<ref name="weizmann-institute" />

Bressler heads a physics research group in the particle and [[astrophysics]] department of the Weizmann Institute and deals with the research into the [[Higgs boson|Higgs Boson]]<ref name="weizmann-institute" />

==Social activism==
=== "Black Flag" protests (2020-2021)===
[[File:Shikma Bressler at a demonstration in Kiryat Bialik March 23, 2023.jpg|thumb|Shikma Bressler at a demonstration in Kiryat Bialik March 23, 2023]]
In March 2020, Bressler founded and led the "[[Protests against Benjamin Netanyahu|Black Flag Protests]]", along with two of her brothers, Yarden and Eyal, and two family friends.<ref name="haaretz-2" /><ref name="new-york-times-august-2023" /> Following the [[2020 Israeli legislative election]]s, President [[Reuven Rivlin]] tasked the chair of the [[Blue and White (political alliance)|Blue and White]] party of forming a government. Outgoing Knesset chair [[Yuli Edelstein]], refused to relinquish his position for the new chair in an attempt to prevent the establishment of a committee which would convene to deliberate on removing [[parliamentary immunity]] of Prime Minister [[Benjamin Netanyahu]].<ref name="onlife">{{cite web |last1=Weisburg |first1=Nitzan |title=Meet the Leader of the "Black Flag" Protest: A Physicist from the Weizmann Institute and a Mother of 5 |url=https://www.onlife.co.il/news/240471 |publisher=OnLife.co.il |access-date=December 2, 2020 |language=he |date=March 26, 2020}}</ref> Bressler and two of her brothers initiated protest convoys to the [[Knesset]] and protests near the homes of Knesset members and members of the [[Blue and White (political party)|Israel Resilience Party]] headed by [[Benny Gantz]].<ref name="jerusalem-post-1">{{Cite web|url=https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/israel-police-ramps-up-security-ahead-of-weekend-demonstrations-637008|title=Israel Police ramps up security ahead of weekend demonstrations|first=Uri|last=Cohen|website=[[The Jerusalem Post]]|date=August 3, 2020|access-date=December 4, 2020}}</ref> The protestors began with three demands.<ref name="makor-rishon-1">{{cite web |last1=Kahana |first1=Eilat |title=Who Is Behind the "Black Flag Protests"? |url=https://www.makorrishon.co.il/news/yoman/247639/ |publisher=[[Makor Rishon]] |access-date=December 3, 2020 |language=he |date=July 16, 2020}}</ref> The first, the election of a new chair of the Knesset after the 3rd elections in a year, while [[Benny Gantz]] and the block of parties opposed to the continuation of Netanyahu's rule should be entrusted with the task of forming a government. Their second demand was the establishment of Knesset committees with parliamentary supervision, and the third demand was the legislation of an amendment to the basic law pertaining to the formation of a government and regulating government powers so that in the future, a person indicted on criminal charges would not be able to run for Prime Minister.<ref name="jerusalem-post-2">{{cite web |last1=REICH |first1=AARON |title=Thousands gather in Tel Aviv for Black Flag protest against coalition |url=https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/thousands-gather-in-tel-aviv-for-black-flag-protest-against-coalition-625911 |publisher=[[The Jerusalem Post]] |access-date=December 4, 2020 |date=April 26, 2020}}</ref><ref name="calcalist-1">{{cite web |last1=Zarchia |first1=Zvi |title=The Black Flag Protest: "Saving the Knesset and Democracy" |url=https://www.calcalist.co.il/local/articles/0,7340,L-3802212,00.html |publisher=[[Calcalist]] |access-date=December 3, 2020 |language=he |date=March 19, 2020}}</ref><ref name="haifa-news">{{cite web |title=Head to Head: Opposers of Netanyahu Facing His Supporters |url=https://haipo.co.il/item/234011 |publisher=Haifa - News |access-date=December 3, 2020 |language=he |date=October 24, 2020}}</ref> The protest movement spread throughout the country and came to be known as "The Black Flag Protest".<ref name="haaretz">{{cite web |last1=Lis |first1=Yonathan |title=Rivlin Tasks Gantz With Formation of Government |url=https://www.haaretz.co.il/news/elections/1.8678945 |publisher=[[Haaretz]] |access-date=November 28, 2020 |language=he |date=March 16, 2020}}</ref><ref name="calcalist">{{cite web |last1=Gorali |first1=Moshe |title=The Health of the Nation or the Health of the Prime Minister |url=https://www.calcalist.co.il/local/articles/0,7340,L-3802155,00.html |publisher=[[Calcalist]] |access-date=November 28, 2020 |language=he |date=March 19, 2020}}</ref><ref name="haaretz-2" />

===Judicial reforms protest (2023)===
[[File:Arrest of Shikma Bressler at a demonstration in Kiryat Bialik March 23, 2023 (cropped).jpg|250px|thumb|Arrest of Shikma Bressler at a demonstration in Kiryat Bialik March 23, 2023]]
[[File:מובילי הצעדה לירושלים.jpg|thumb|Leaders of the protest march to Jerusalem (from left to right: [[Ran Harnevo]], Shikma Bressler, [[Moshe Radman]], [[Ami Dror]])]]
On March 23, 2023, Bressler was detained by police during one of the many "Day of Disruption" protests held across Israel as part of the [[2023 Israeli anti-judicial reform protests]]. She was later released. Former Prime Minister and protest leader, [[Ehud Barak]], tweeted that Bressler's arrest was "dictatorship in action". Knesset Member and [[Israeli Labor Party|Labor party]] leader, [[Merav Michaeli]], stated that "in a normal country Shikma Bressler would be given the [[Israel Prize]]. In the state of Netanyahu and  [[Itamar Ben-Gvir|Ben-Gvir]] she is arrested as a common criminal."<ref name="jerusalem-post-march-23-2023">{{cite web |last1=STARR |first1=MICHAEL |title=Protest leader Shikma Bressler arrested in judicial reform demonstration |url=https://www.jpost.com/breaking-news/article-735166 |publisher=[[The Jerusalem Post]] |access-date=23 March 2023 |date=23 March 2023}}</ref><ref name="times-of-israel-march-23-2023">{{cite web |last1=SHARON |first1=JEREMY |title=Protest leader Shikma Bressler arrested, later released; ex-PM Barak: 'Dictatorship in action' |url=https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/protest-leader-shikma-bressler-arrested-later-released-ex-pm-barak-dictatorship-in-action/ |publisher=[[The Times of Israel]] |access-date=23 March 2023 |date=23 March 2023}}</ref> In July 2023, Bressler announced they would march from Tel Aviv to Jerusalem.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/protest-leaders-announce-march-from-tel-aviv-to-jerusalem/ |title=Protest leaders announce march from Tel Aviv to Jerusalem |publisher=Times of Israel |access-date=July 19, 2023}}</ref> The five day march from Kaplan Street in [[Tel Aviv]] to [[Jerusalem]] was a protest against the law proposal to reduce the [[Reasonableness|reasonableness clause]].<ref name="walla-july-2023">{{cite web |last1=Sela |first1=Uri |title=Hundreds of protesters march on foot from Tel Aviv to Jerusalem: "We will rebuild the nation" |url=https://news.walla.co.il/item/3595203 |publisher=[[Walla! Communications Ltd|Walla!]] |access-date=24 July 2023 |language=he |date=18 July 2023}}</ref><ref name="democrat-tv-july-2023">{{cite web |title=The journey to the Knesset continues - a special broadcast to cover the great protest campaign against the coup d'état |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3i3uaJjs7vg |publisher=Democrat TV |access-date=24 July 2023 |language=he |date=19 July 2023}}</ref> It is considered one of the largest protest-marches ever held in Israel.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2023-07-21 |title=Thousands march from Tel Aviv to Jerusalem to protest Israeli government's judicial overhaul plan |url=https://apnews.com/article/israel-netanyahu-judicial-protest-march-jerusalem-7ac735c991253e35189489c76cc4b7a5 |access-date=2023-11-22 |website=AP News |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |title=המפגינים שינו את הכללים, וירושלים ראתה צעדת מחאה חסרת תקדים |language=he |work=הארץ |url=https://www.haaretz.co.il/news/politi/2023-07-22/ty-article-magazine/.premium/00000189-7ea9-de6d-a1ef-ffeba7df0000 |access-date=2023-11-22}}</ref>

In September 2023 it was claimed that Bressler was charging US$20,000 for a meeting in person (or a personal Zoom meeting) with her while in New York City which caused a vocal outrage amongst her supporters and opponents alike.<ref>[https://www.israelhayom.co.il/news/local/article/14610648 "Big Money in the Big Apple: Shikma Bressler's price for a meeting with New Yorkers is published] (Hebrew), [[Israel HaYom]], September 14th, 20223.</ref><ref>[https://www.israelnationalnews.com/news/377012 US supporters fume: $20,000 to meet with the leader of the anti-government protests?], [[Arutz Sheva]], Israel National News, Sep 14, 2023, 4:30 PM (GMT+3)</ref><ref name=":0">{{Cite news |last=Edelson |first=Daniel |last2= |first2= |date=2023-09-14 |title=Judicial reform protest fundraiser U-turns on '$20,000 cup of coffee' perk, exposes production costs |language= |work=Ynetnews |url=https://www.ynetnews.com/article/hjitsqgyt |access-date=2023-09-19}}</ref> The protest movement Kaplan Force said however the event was an uncoordinated private initiative, that Bressler didn't engage in paid meetings and wasn't expected to be in the United States.<ref name=":0" />

== Lawsuits ==
In February 2024 Bressler announced she had filed a defamation suit against Likud MK [[Tally Gotliv]] for falsely claiming that Bressler had "communicated with Hamas leader Yahya Sinwar before October 7." Both Bressler and [[Mossad]] denied Gotliv's claim. Prime Minister [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] also noted that Gotliv's claims were falsehoods.<ref>The Jerusalem Post, "Protest leader sues Likud MK for false claim of Hamas affiliation," by Tamar Uriel-Beeri, February 1, 2024 [https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/politics-and-diplomacy/article-784807]</ref>

In 2025, Israeli Prime Minister [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] initiated a series of defamation lawsuits against several individuals, including Shikma Bressler, in response to allegations linking him to financial dealings with Qatar in background of [[Qatari connection affair|Qatargate]]. In defense, Bressler launched a crowdfunding campaign that rapidly raised funds to cover her legal expenses.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Persico |first=Oren |date=2025-04-28 |title=Netanyahu Files Sixth Defamation Lawsuit - Again Regarding His Ties with Qatar |url=https://www.the7eye.org.il/551193 |access-date=2025-06-02 |website=העין השביעית |language=he-IL}}</ref>

== Awards and recognition ==
In 2016, Bressler received the [[Charles Clore]] award for research.<ref name="wis-awards-2016">{{cite web |title=Awards 2016 |url=https://heb.wis-wander.weizmann.ac.il/people-and-events-he/n-8286 |publisher=[[Weizmann Institute of Science]] |access-date=November 28, 2020 |language=he |date=2016}}</ref>

In 2020, Bressler appeared in ''[[TheMarker]]''{{'}}s list of 100 most influential people in Israel and in ''[[Forbes]]'' magazine's list of 50 most influential women in Israel.<ref name="the-marker">{{cite journal |title=100 Most Influential People in Israel 2020 |url=https://www.themarker.com/magazine/EXT-INTERACTIVE-1.9094330 |journal=[[TheMarker]] |access-date=November 28, 2020 |language=he |date=2020}}</ref><ref name="forbes">{{cite web |title=PowerWomen 2020 |url=https://forbes.co.il/lists/2020powerwomen/ |work=[[Forbes]] |access-date=November 29, 2020 |language=he}}</ref>

In 2021, Bressler received the Nathan Rosen Experimental Physics Prize for Young Physicists award from the Israeli Physical Society (IPS).<ref name="IPS-awards-2021">{{cite web |title=IPS Awards 2021 |url=https://www.israelphysicalsociety.org/ips-conference-2021/prizes |publisher=The Israeli Physical Society |access-date=February 1, 2021 |language=en |date=2021 |archive-date=April 18, 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210418235535/https://www.israelphysicalsociety.org/ips-conference-2021/prizes |url-status=dead }}</ref>
